sections.description:
Elevate Your Site’s Inclusivity with A11y Accessibility Enhancer – The Top Free WordPress Accessibility Plugin

In today’s digital landscape, accessibility isn’t optional—it’s essential. A11y Accessibility Enhancer is the best free WordPress accessibility plugin for WCAG 2.2 and ADA compliance, empowering users with a dynamic, customizable widget to adjust fonts, contrast, spacing, links, motion, and more. Lightweight (under 50KB), multilingual (36 languages), and packed with auto-fixes for ARIA, headings, and alt text, it transforms your site into an inclusive powerhouse—perfect for blogs, WooCommerce stores, or agencies using Elementor/Divi.

Check out this demo of the plugin in action:

It shows how easy it is to add accessibility features.

Boost SEO, cut bounce rates, and sidestep lawsuits while serving 1B+ users with disabilities. From screen readers to color blindness filters, A11y ensures everyone experiences your content effortlessly. Trusted by thousands—join the joy at PluginJoy!

Key Features

  • Dynamic Widget Controls: Tap for font resize (WCAG 1.4.4), contrast modes (1.4.3), spacing tweaks (1.4.12), link underlines, grayscale, & motion reduction (2.3.3). Hold for advanced: Dyslexia fonts, color-blind filters, epilepsy-safe flashes.
  • Text-to-Speech (TTS): Select & read aloud in any language—enhances screen reader flow.
  • Free Auto-Fixes: Smart ARIA stripper, auto-alt cleaner, heading enforcer, global contrast override, touch target expander (2.5.5), & form labels (3.3.2).
  • Multilingual Magic: 12 languages with flag selector—global-ready.
  • Admin Power-Ups: Color contrast tester, WCAG reports, AI alt text (Pro). Customize widget styles, sounds, & vibrations.
  • Pro Exclusives ($39): Full audits, keyboard nav, custom icons—upgrade at PluginJoy.

Real Wins: Improves Lighthouse scores, ranks higher for “free WordPress accessibility plugin,” and delights users—pure joy!

Explore full docs and check out the Live Demo
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a11y-enhancer/ or search “A11y Accessibility Enhancer” in Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate via Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Customize at Settings > A11y Enhancer—toggle features & styles.

No code needed—works with any theme/builder!
sections.faq:
Is A11y the best free WordPress accessibility plugin for WCAG/ADA?

Yes! It auto-fixes core issues (ARIA, alts, headings) and offers a user-friendly widget—more comprehensive than WP Accessibility. Covers WCAG 2.2 AA essentials; Pro for full audits. Learn more.

How does the widget work?

Tap buttons for quick adjustments (e.g., font +); hold for advanced (e.g., Joy Burst mode). Visual indicators show levels—intuitive for all users.

Does it support multilingual sites?

Absolutely—36 languages for TTS & UI, with flag dropdown. Ideal for global WordPress a11y.

Any performance impact?

Zero—ultra-light code boosts SEO without bloat. Compatible with WooCommerce, Elementor, & more.

How to fix common errors?

Use auto-fixes toggles; test with WAVE or Lighthouse. For troubleshooting, check our guide.

What’s the Pro upgrade worth?

For $39: AI audits, custom shapes, no branding—get it now.

Works on mobile?

Yes—vibrations & touch-optimized for iOS/Android.
